HomeHero.welcomeDescription: Mavidiyo okhudza chikhulupiriro ochokera mu laibulale yathu, kuti akulimbikitseni, akudzutseni, ndi kukuthandizani kulingalira mozama.
HomeHero.morningTitle: Mwadzuka bwanji! Mphindi za Baibulo za lero zikukuyembekezerani.
HomeHero.morningDescription: Yambani tsiku lanu ndi mphindi za Baibulo zolimbikitsa, zokonzedwa kuti zikulimbikitseni ndi kukweza mzimu wanu.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Mwaswera bwanji! Mphindi za Baibulo za tsiku lanu.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Zinthu za Baibulo zolimbikitsa, zabwino pa nthawi yopuma masana kapena kuti mupitirize kulimbikitsidwa.
HomeHero.eveningTitle: Madzulo abwino! Pumulani ndi mphindi za Baibulo.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Mphindi za Baibulo zamtendere zokuthandizani kulingalira ndi kupeza chitonthozo pamene tsiku lanu likutha.
HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Zokolola zafika. Bwerani nafe pamene tikugawana Uthenga Wabwino ndi dziko lonse pogwiritsa ntchito njira za digito.
HomeHero.togetherDescription: Kuti amve ndi kuona chikondi cha Yesu m’chinenero chawo, pomwe ali.
HomeHero.togetherAction: Tengani nawo mbali mu ntchito yathu

Mission.headline: Uthenga susintha. Njira imene anthu amaonera ndiyo ikusintha.
Mission.intro: Tikumanganso laibulale yathu ya mavidiyo ndi zida zathu kuyambira pansi, ndipo tikuika ntchito ya zaka zambiri yomasulira pa malo amene anthu amasonkhana kale, kuonera, ndi kugawana.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Laibulale ya mafilimu yomasuliridwa kwambiri padziko lonse
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Ntchito ya zaka zambiri yomasulira, yochitidwa ndi anzathu odalirika a mu utumiki, yamanga laibulale ya zinenero zikwizikwi kuti anthu akumane ndi nkhani ya Yesu m’chinenero chimene chimawafika pamtima kwambiri.
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Tikumanganso njira yofotokozera nkhani za Uthenga Wabwino mwa zithunzi, kuphatikiza kumasulira kodalirika ndi njira zamakono kuti uthenga uyende momasuka pa nsanja, zikhalidwe, ndi zowonera zosiyanasiyana.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Kuposa laibulale. Gulu lodzipereka ku utumiki.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project ndi gulu la padziko lonse la omasulira, akatswiri a media, okonza, ndi opanga, amene akusandutsa zaka zambiri za utumiki kukhala zida za opanga ophunzira kulikonse.
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Imalumikiza oonera ndi mipata yeniyeni pa ulendo wawo wauzimu, kuwathandiza kutenga sitepe yotsatira yolowa mu chiyanjano, m’Malemba, kapena mu utumiki.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Laibulale yaikulu ya media ya Chikhristu yokhala ndi mavidiyo, mafilimu, ndi zothandizira zikwizikwi m’zinenero zambiri, za utumiki ndi ulaliki padziko lonse.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Kuyang’anira mavidiyo, kugawa zinthu, kuchita nawo kwa omvera, ndi kusanthula, zopangidwa kuti zithandize mautumiki kufikira anthu ambiri mogwira mtima.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Thandizani kumanga {accent} wa zida za utumiki
Mission.inviteBody: Tikuitana ogwira ntchito ya utumiki, opanga, ndi anzathu kuti ayambe kugwiritsa ntchito msanga. Yesani zida zatsopano poyamba, perekani maganizo, ndipo thandizani kuumba zinthu zopangidwira ntchito yeniyeni ya utumiki.
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: Imatsegula tsamba la utumiki la Jesus Film
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Imatsegula tsamba la utumiki la Jesus Film pa gawo la mapu a ntchito
Mission.betaCardAriaHint: Imatsegula kulembetsa kwa beta mu msakatuli wanu
